# E0333: a mapping is an expression the lens language does not have

A mapping is a reference into the source instance, a constant, a nested body,
drop, orelse, remap or each. Computed expressions are not part of the lens
language yet.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a: int
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a: int
	b: int
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b: v0_0.a + 1
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0333]: b: a mapping is a reference to v0_0, a constant, a nested body, drop, orelse, remap or each; other expressions are not supported yet
 --> 1.0.thema:9:6
  |
9 |         b: v0_0.a + 1
  |            ^^^^
  |
```
